# RP Custom Labels

RP is a factory-direct custom label and sticker manufacturer for overseas B2B buyers.

Primary services:
- Custom peptide vial labels and research vial labels
- Custom cartoon stickers, die cut stickers, kiss cut stickers and sticker sheets
- Custom beverage labels, waterproof bottle labels, clear labels, roll labels and UV DTF cup transfers

Core buyer terms:
- MOQ starts from 100 pcs for many custom projects
- Free design support
- Free digital proof before production
- Sample lead time is usually 1-2 days after details are confirmed
- Bulk production is usually 10-12 days after proof approval
- Worldwide shipping support
